items.exampleCN: 它是 along 内部那个古老前缀。

items.example: It supplies the idea of length in andlang.
items.exampleCN: 它为 andlang 提供了长度的观念。

items.meaning: from one end to the other
items.example: It is the first element of alongside.
items.exampleCN: 它是 alongside 的第一部分。

items.example: It is the second element of alongside.
items.exampleCN: 它是 alongside 的第二部分。

items.example: It closes the compound alongside.
items.exampleCN: 它收束了 alongside 这个复合词。

items.example: It forms alongshore.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alongshore。

items.meaning: marks the relation between two nouns
items.meaningCN: 标示两个名词之间的关系
items.example: It completes the form alongside of.
items.exampleCN: 它补成 alongside of 这一形式。

items.meaning: an old ending added to adverbs
items.meaningCN: 加在副词后的古老词尾
items.example: It forms alongst.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alongst。

definition_zh: 已经；早已；提前；竟然已经（表惊讶）；（口语）够了、快点儿吧
definition_en: before now, earlier than expected, or used in informal speech to show impatience
core_image: 茶还冒着热气，桌上的事却已经办完了
scene: 散会之后，走廊里还站着几个不肯走的人。By the time we arrived, the discussion had already ended.
sceneCN: 这里 already 是「早已」（第 4 个义项：在过去某一时点之前就已完成）；句意为等我们赶到时，讨论早已结束。画面里可辨认的是空会议室与亮着的走廊灯。

pos.zh: 副词：已经；早已；提前；竟然已经；（口语）够了、快点吧

forms.label: 副词原形（无屈折变化，也没有比较级）

derivatives.zh: 由 all 与 ready 两个词分写而成，义为「全都准备好了」，与 already 的「已经」不同
already 的第二成分，义为「准备好的」，是这个词的构词来源之一
由 ready 加后缀 -ly 构成，义为「轻而易举地、乐意地」，与 already 同一词根

senses.title: Before now
senses.definition: before or by the present moment, so that the action or state is complete now
senses.definitionCN: 在此刻之前或到此刻为止，动作或状态现在已经完成
senses.example: I have already read the file you sent this morning.
senses.exampleCN: 你今天上午发来的文件我已经看过了。
senses.why: The word is all plus ready: a thing is in the state of being fully ready, and that readiness is reached by the time we speak, so the action is already done.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 all 加 ready：某件事处在「完全就绪」的状态，而这份就绪在说话时已经达到，所以动作已经完成，这就是「已经」。

senses.title: Earlier than expected
senses.definition: before the time that was expected or arranged, so that something happens too soon
senses.definitionCN: 在预期或约定的时间之前，因而某事发生得偏早
senses.example: The apples were ripe already in early August, weeks ahead of the usual season.
senses.exampleCN: 苹果在八月初就熟了，比寻常季节早了好几个星期。
senses.why: Ready has a calendar in it: something fully ready has arrived at its moment. If that moment comes sooner than the calendar says, already marks the early arrival.
senses.whyCN: ready 里含着一份时间表：完全就绪就意味着到了时候。若这个时候比日历所写的来得早，already 就标出这种「提前」。

senses.title: So soon? In surprised questions
senses.definition: used in a question to express surprise that something has happened so soon
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句，表示对某事发生得如此之早感到意外
senses.example: Are you leaving already? The party has only just started.
senses.exampleCN: 你这就要走了？聚会才刚开始啊。
senses.why: The early arrival that already reports can clash with the speaker's expectation, and a question turns that clash into surprise.
senses.whyCN: already 报告的「早到」会和说话人的预期相撞；把这句话变成疑问，相撞就变成了惊讶。

senses.title: Before a point in the past
senses.definition: with the past perfect, before a particular moment in the past
senses.definitionCN: 与过去完成时连用，表示在过去某个特定时点之前就已经如此
senses.example: By the time the doctor arrived, the fever had already broken.
senses.exampleCN: 医生赶到时，高烧已经退了。
senses.why: If readiness can be measured from the present, it can also be measured from any point in the past; the word simply moves its reference point backwards.
senses.whyCN: 既然「就绪」可以从此刻往回量，也就可以从过去任何一点往回量；这个词只是把参照点往后挪，于是表示「此前就已」。

senses.title: Enough already: stop
senses.definition: in the informal phrase enough already, used to tell someone to stop saying or doing something
senses.definitionCN: 用于口语短语 enough already，叫某人别再讲或别再做了
senses.example: Enough already, we have heard the same complaint three times.
senses.exampleCN: 够了，同一个抱怨我们已经听了三遍。
senses.why: The word marks that a limit has been reached before the speaker expected it; in this phrase that limit is patience, and the sentence ends the matter.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本来说「限度比预想更早到达」；在这一说法里，到达限度的是耐心，于是整句话就是在叫停。

senses.title: Go already: hurry up
senses.definition: in informal American speech, placed at the end of an order to urge someone to act at once
senses.definitionCN: 在美式口语中置于命令句末，催促对方立刻行动
senses.example: Hurry up and get in the car already, or we will miss the ferry.
senses.exampleCN: 快点儿上车吧，不然我们就赶不上渡轮了。
senses.why: Here the expected moment is now, and the speaker insists that it has arrived; the early arrival becomes pure impatience.
senses.whyCN: 这里预期的时刻就是现在，说话人坚持它已经到了；「早到」于是变成纯粹的不耐烦，成了催促。

intro.en: Already is a native English compound of all and ready, and its history is the history of being fully prepared.
intro.cn: already 是 all 与 ready 组成的英语本族复合词，它的历史就是「完全准备好」的历史。

items.en: Eall meant all or wholly, and it was commonly used to intensify the word it stood beside.
items.cn: eall 意为「全部、完全」，常用来加强它旁边的词。

items.en: Rǣde meant prepared or prompt; it is generally connected with a Germanic root for arranging or making ready, though the deeper link is uncertain.
items.cn: rǣde 意为「准备好的、迅速的」；一般认为它与日耳曼语中表示「安排、备好」的词根有关，更早的联系不确定。

items.en: The two words were written separately as al redy around the year 1300, meaning fully ready.
items.cn: 约在十三世纪末十四世纪初，这两个词分写作 al redy，意为「完全就绪」。

items.en: The parts fused into one word, and the sense before this time is recorded in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 两部分合并成一个词，「在此以前」这一义项一般认为自十四世纪起有记录。

items.en: The emphatic and impatient uses at the end of a sentence, such as enough already, belong to modern informal English.
items.cn: 句末表示强调与不耐烦的用法，如 enough already，属于现代口语英语。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the two parts of the compound and the spelling that is so often confused with it; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of time that answer a similar question.
note.cn: 形近组收复合词的两个部分，以及最常与它混淆的那个写法；近义组收回答同类时间问题的副词。

entries.definition: The second element, meaning prepared or prompt.
entries.definitionCN: 复合词的第二部分，义为「准备好的、迅速的」。

entries.definition: An adverb from ready meaning easily or willingly; it shares the root but is not a form of already.
entries.definitionCN: 由 ready 构成的副词，义为「轻而易举地、乐意地」，与 already 同根，但不是它的变形。

entries.definition: Two separate words meaning that everyone or everything is prepared; often confused with already in writing.
entries.definitionCN: 两个分写的词，义为「全都准备好了」；书写时最常与 already 混淆。

entries.definition: A one-word spelling of all right; it merely looks similar and comes from all plus right.
entries.definitionCN: all right 的连写形式；只是拼写相近，词源不同，来自 all 加 right。

entries.definition: Up to now, used mostly in questions and negatives; it asks about the same point in time.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「还、尚、已经」，多用于疑问与否定，问的是同一个时间点。

entries.definition: At an earlier time; a more formal way of pointing backwards than already.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「先前、以前」，比 already 更正式地指向更早的时间。

entries.definition: Before a particular event, especially in advance of preparation.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「事先、预先」，尤指在准备上先于某件事。

entries.definition: The comparative of soon, used when something comes earlier than another thing or than expected.
entries.definitionCN: soon 的比较级，用于某事比另一事或比预期更早发生。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real compound all plus ready and the confusion with the two separate words all ready.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的记忆钩子使用真实的复合 all 加 ready，以及它与两个分写词的混淆。

normal.en: All ready means fully prepared, and being fully prepared early gives already.
normal.cn: all ready 是「完全备好」；早早完全备好，就得到 already。

normal.en: Write one word for the adverb, two words for the state of being prepared.
normal.cn: 副词写成一个词，表示「都准备好了」则写两个词。

normal.en: Already has a calendar inside it: it compares the moment with the expected time.
normal.cn: already 里藏着一份日历：它把当前时刻和预期时刻作比较。

normal.en: With the past perfect, move the same comparison back to a past point.
normal.cn: 配过去完成时，就是把同一个比较挪到过去的某一点。

normal.en: Enough already and go already keep only the impatience, not the timetable.
normal.cn: enough already 与 go already 只剩不耐烦，时间表已经不见了。

abstract.en: A cup still steaming, while the work on the desk is finished and the chair pushed in.
abstract.cn: 茶还冒着热气，桌上的活已经做完，椅子也推回去了。

abstract.en: A clock whose hands jump forward before the hour it was supposed to show.
abstract.cn: 一只钟的表针，在它本该指到的时刻之前就跳了过去。

abstract.en: A door already closing while the host is still saying goodbye.
abstract.cn: 主人还在道别，门却已经关上了。

examples.en: I have already read the file you sent this morning.
examples.cn: 你今天上午发来的文件我已经看过了。

examples.en: The apples were ripe already in early August, weeks ahead of the usual season.
examples.cn: 苹果在八月初就熟了，比寻常季节早了好几个星期。

examples.en: Are you leaving already? The party has only just started.
examples.cn: 你这就要走了？聚会才刚开始啊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥尔瑞迪」——茶还热着，事却办完了：已经；提前。

root: 古英语 eall「全部」加 rǣde「准备好的、迅速的」构成 al redy，约十三世纪末分写作两个词，后合为 already。核心意思是「完全就绪」，就绪早于预期，便引申出「已经、提前、竟然已经」，口语中再引申为不耐烦的催促。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses all compare a moment of readiness with a timetable: now, earlier than expected, surprisingly early, before a past point, past patience, or past the point of waiting.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项都在把「就绪的时刻」与一份时间表相比：此刻、早于预期、早得令人意外、早于过去某点、超出耐心、超出等待的限度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the tea is still hot, but the work on the desk is already finished.
core.cn: 核心意象：茶还热着，桌上的活却已经做完了。

branches.en: THE PRESENT: the prepared state has been reached by the moment of speaking.
branches.cn: 此刻线：到说话这一刻，「就绪」的状态已经达到。

branches.en: THE SCHEDULE: readiness arrives before the expected time.
branches.cn: 日程线：就绪比预期的时间来得早。

branches.en: THE SURPRISE: a question marks that this early arrival was not expected.
branches.cn: 惊讶线：用疑问句标出这种早到出乎意料。

branches.en: THE PAST: before a past point, the state was complete even then.
branches.cn: 过去线：在过去某一点之前，状态在彼时就已经完成。

branches.en: THE IMPATIENCE: the same early completion turns into a way of saying stop or hurry up.
branches.cn: 不耐烦线：同一个「提早完成」变成叫停或催促的说法。

intro.en: Already is a fused compound of two Old English adjectives, and English later built a small family on ready with ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: already 由两个古英语形容词融合而成，英语后来又以 ready 为基础、用普通后缀扩展出一个小词族。

latinIntro.en: Both elements are Germanic and neither has a Latin cognate, so the Latin column stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分都属日耳曼语，都没有拉丁语同源词，所以拉丁语一栏留空。

items.example: It intensifies the second element of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它加强复合词的第二部分。

items.example: It supplies the sense of being prepared.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「已经备好」这层意思。

items.example: It is the older written shape of ready.
items.exampleCN: 它是 ready 较早的书写形式。

items.example: It appears in the two-word spelling al redy.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在分写的 al redy 里。

items.meaning: the fused form before modern spelling
items.meaningCN: 现代拼写之前的融合形式
items.example: The fused spelling is the direct ancestor of already.
items.exampleCN: 这个融合拼写是 already 的直接祖先。

items.example: It forms unready.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 unready。

items.example: It forms readiness.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 readiness。

items.example: It forms readily.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 readily。

definition_zh: 也；还；此外；而且；同样地；不仅……而且
definition_en: in addition, as well, or in the same way, used to add a second person, thing or point
core_image: 第二样东西被摆到第一样旁边，处在同一行上
scene: 新来的同事讲完方案，又补了一句自己周末可以加班。The same rule also applies to part-time staff.
sceneCN: 这里 also 是「也」（第 1 个义项：把同类的人或事添进已经说过的内容）；句意为同一条规定也适用于兼职员工。画面里可辨认的是白板、排班表与半开的百叶窗。

pos.zh: 副词：也；还；此外；而且；同样地

forms.label: 副词原形（无屈折变化，也没有比较级）
构词前项（用于 also-ran 等复合词）

derivatives.zh: 由 also 与 ran 组合固化成名词，义为「落选者；未获胜者」
一般认为由 ealswa 弱化而来，义为「如同；作为」，与 also 同源
also 的第二成分，义为「如此；这样」，是这个词的构词来源之一

senses.title: In addition, too
senses.definition: used to add another person or thing of the same kind to what has just been said
senses.definitionCN: 把同类的另一个人或另一件事添到刚说过的内容里
senses.example: She speaks Japanese and also a little Korean.
senses.exampleCN: 她会说日语，还会一点韩语。
senses.why: Old English ealswa meant quite so or wholly in that way; saying it of a second thing places that thing in the same way as the first.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ealswa 意为「完全如此」；把这句话再说给第二样东西，就是把它放进与第一样相同的情形里，于是表示「也」。

senses.title: Moreover, besides
senses.definition: used at the beginning of a sentence or clause to add a further point or reason
senses.definitionCN: 用于句子或分句开头，补充另一个论点或理由
senses.example: The route is shorter. Also, it avoids the toll road.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路线更短。此外，它还避开了收费公路。
senses.why: The same so is now applied to a whole statement rather than to a word: the new sentence is added on the same pattern as the one before it.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「如此」不再作用于一个词，而是作用于整句：新句子按前一句的样式接上去，于是成了「此外、而且」。

senses.title: Likewise, equally
senses.definition: in formal use, in the same way or to the same degree as something already mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 在正式用法中，表示以相同的方式或达到相同的程度
senses.example: The same courtesy is owed to guests and also to strangers.
senses.exampleCN: 同样的礼数要给予客人，也一样要给予陌生人。
senses.why: When in that same way is said of a second case, the two cases are put on one level; the additive word then leans toward equally.
senses.whyCN: 当「以同样的方式」被用来说第二个情形时，两个情形被摆到同一高度，这个表示添加的词便偏向「同样地、也一样」。

senses.title: Not only but also
senses.definition: in the correlative pair not only but also, used to add a second item that is often stronger
senses.definitionCN: 用于成对结构 not only but also，添加第二项，且第二项往往分量更重
senses.example: The scheme not only cost more but also took two extra years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案不仅花费更多，还多耗了两年。
senses.why: The additive word is pulled into a paired frame: the first item is marked as not enough, and also carries the weight of the second.
senses.whyCN: 这个表示添加的词被拉进成对的框架：前一项被标为「不止于此」，also 便把分量加到后一项上，形成「不仅……而且」。

senses.title: Also-ran: one who merely takes part
senses.definition: in the compound noun also-ran, a person or horse that takes part but does not win or finish among the leaders
senses.definitionCN: 复合名词 also-ran，指参加比赛或竞争却未获胜、未名列前茅的人或马
senses.example: The paper treated the third candidate as an also-ran from the start.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸从一开始就把第三位候选人当成陪跑者。
senses.why: In old race reports a horse that also ran was merely listed among the starters, not among the winners; the phrase froze into a noun for anyone who only takes part.
senses.whyCN: 旧日赛马报道里，说某匹马「也跑了」，意即它只列在出赛名单里、不在获胜者中；这个说法凝固成名词，指一切只是陪跑的人。

intro.en: Also is a native English compound of all and so, and its oldest sense was not addition but complete agreement.
intro.cn: also 是 all 与 so 组成的英语本族复合词，它最古老的意思不是「添加」，而是「完全如此」。

items.en: The two elements go back to reconstructed Germanic forms meaning all and so; both are starred forms rebuilt by comparison.
items.cn: 两个成分都可追溯到重构的日耳曼语形式，分别表示「全部」与「如此」；两者都是比较得出的星号形式。

items.en: Ealswa was written as one word and meant quite so, wholly thus; it could introduce a comparison as well as an addition.
items.cn: ealswa 写作一个词，意为「完全如此」，既能引出比较，也能引出添加。

items.en: The form shrank to also, and the additive sense in addition became the dominant one.
items.cn: 这个词缩略为 also，「另外再加上」的添加义逐渐成为主要意思。

items.en: The weakened form as is generally traced to the same ealswa, and also began to appear at the head of a sentence; exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为弱化形式 as 也出自同一个 ealswa；also 开始出现在句首，确切年代不确定。

items.en: The correlative not only but also settles into formal prose, and the racing phrase also ran hardens into the noun also-ran in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 成对结构 not only but also 在正式书面语中固定下来；赛马说法 also ran 在十九世纪凝固成名词 also-ran。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the two elements of the compound, the weakened form that came from the same word, and a compound of all with another word; the near-meaning group holds the common synonyms for addition.
note.cn: 形近组收复合词的两个成分、由同一个词弱化而来的形式，以及 all 与另一个词组成的复合词；近义组收表示添加的常见同义词。

entries.definition: A conjunction and preposition meaning like or in the role of; generally taken as a worn-down form of ealswa.
entries.definitionCN: 连词与介词，义为「如同、作为」；一般认为它是 ealswa 磨损后的形式。

entries.definition: The second element of the compound, meaning in that way or to that degree.
entries.definitionCN: 复合词的第二部分，义为「以那种方式、到那种程度」。

entries.definition: A noun for a person or horse that takes part but does not win.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「落选者、未获胜者」，指参加却未获胜的人或马。

entries.definition: A conjunction meaning despite the fact that; it merely looks similar and comes from all plus though.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，义为「虽然、尽管」；只是拼写相近，词源不同，来自 all 加 though。

entries.definition: In addition, usually at the end of a clause; the plainest everyday match for also.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「也」，通常置于句末，是 also 最日常的对应词。

entries.definition: In addition and moreover, often opening a sentence with a further reason.
entries.definitionCN: 副词与介词，义为「此外、而且」，常用来在句首补一个理由。

entries.definition: In the same way; the formal equivalent of the equally sense of also.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「同样地」，是 also 表示「同样」时的正式对应词。

entries.definition: In addition to what has been said; a formal sentence adverb for adding an argument.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「而且、此外」，是正式书面语中补充论点的句首副词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real compound ealswa and the frames the word actually appears in, including the racing phrase behind also-ran.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的记忆钩子使用真实的复合词 ealswa、这个词实际出现的句式，以及 also-ran 背后的赛马说法。

normal.en: Ealswa is all plus so: wholly in that way.
normal.cn: ealswa 就是 all 加 so：完全以那种方式。

normal.en: Say wholly so about a second thing and you get in addition.
normal.cn: 把「完全如此」说给第二样东西，就得到「另外也」。

normal.en: As is generally taken to be the same word worn down.
normal.cn: 一般认为 as 就是同一个词磨损后的样子。

normal.en: Not only but also is a frame: the first item is declared insufficient.
normal.cn: not only but also 是一个框架：前一项被宣布为「不够」。

normal.en: Also-ran comes from race reports: the horse also ran, but did not win.
normal.cn: also-ran 出自赛马报道：那匹马「也跑了」，但没有赢。

abstract.en: Two cups are set on the same shelf, one beside the other.
abstract.cn: 两只杯子被摆在同一层架子上，一只挨着一只。

abstract.en: A hand adds a second item to a list that already has one line.
abstract.cn: 一只手在本已有一行的清单上添上第二项。

abstract.en: At the race, one horse crosses the line first and the others are only recorded as having run.
abstract.cn: 赛场上有一匹马先过线，其余的马只被记下「也跑过」。

examples.en: She speaks Japanese and also a little Korean.
examples.cn: 她会说日语，还会一点韩语。

examples.en: The new route is shorter and also avoids the toll road.
examples.cn: 新路线更短，还避开了收费公路。

examples.en: The storm not only closed the port but also cut the power.
examples.cn: 这场风暴不仅关闭了港口，还切断了电力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥尔索」——第二样东西被摆到第一样旁边：也；而且。

root: 古英语 ealswa「完全如此」，由 eall「全部」加 swa「如此」构成，本义是「以完全相同的方式」。中古英语缩略为 also，添加义「也、另外」成为主用法；一般认为弱化形式 as 同出此词。十九世纪赛马说法 also ran 凝固成名词 also-ran。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses all do one thing: put a second item on the same line as the first, whether that line is a phrase, a sentence, an argument, a paired frame or a race result.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都做同一件事：把第二样东西放到第一样所在的那一行上，这一行可以是一个短语、一个句子、一个论点、一个成对框架，或一份赛马成绩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a second object is set on the same line as the first.
core.cn: 核心意象：第二样东西被摆到第一样所在的那一行上。

branches.en: THE ITEM: a second person or thing is placed in the same situation as the first.
branches.cn: 条目线：第二个人或物被放进与第一个相同的情形里。

branches.en: THE SENTENCE: the addition is now a whole further statement, often with a reason.
branches.cn: 句子线：添加的单位变成整整一句补充，常带一个理由。

branches.en: THE DEGREE: the second case is put on the same level rather than merely added.
branches.cn: 程度线：第二个情形被摆到同一高度，而不只是被添上。

branches.en: THE FRAME: paired with not only, the word carries weight to the second half.
branches.cn: 框架线：与 not only 配对时，这个词把分量加到后半句。

branches.en: THE RACE: a horse that also ran becomes the noun for anyone who merely takes part.
branches.cn: 赛马线：一匹「也跑了」的马，变成指一切只是陪跑者的名词。

intro.en: Also is a fused compound of two Old English words, and the second element survives in the compound noun also-ran.
intro.cn: also 由两个古英语词融合而成，它的第二成分还保留在复合名词 also-ran 里。

latinIntro.en: Both elements are Germanic and have no Latin cognate, so the Latin column stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分都属日耳曼语，没有拉丁语同源词，所以拉丁语一栏留空。

items.example: It strengthens the second element of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它加强复合词的第二部分。

items.example: It supplies the idea of being in that way.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「以那种方式」这层意思。

items.example: It is the direct ancestor of also.
items.exampleCN: 它是 also 的直接祖先。

items.example: It appears in the reduced Middle English spelling.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在中古英语的缩略拼写里。

items.example: It is generally traced to the same ealswa.
items.exampleCN: 一般认为它也出自同一个 ealswa。

items.example: It is the second half of the old compound.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个古老复合词的后半。

items.example: It forms also-ran.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 also-ran。

items.example: The second part of also-ran records that the horse ran.
items.exampleCN: also-ran 的后半记录这匹马确实跑过。

definition_zh: 改变；改动；使不同；（按尺寸）改衣服；给（动物）做绝育手术；另一个自我
definition_en: to make something or someone different, to adjust a garment so that it fits, to neuter an animal, or, in the phrase alter ego, a second self
core_image: 裁缝的粉线在旧衣上重新划过，同一块布被改成另一个样子
scene: 裁缝铺里，一件旧大衣挂在镜子前，两只袖口明显太长。She altered the sleeves so that the coat finally fitted her.
sceneCN: 这里 alter 是「按尺寸改衣服」（第 2 个义项：为合身而修改衣物）；句意为她把袖子改短，大衣终于合身了。画面里是镜子、粉线与针线盒。

pos.zh: 及物动词：改变；改动；修改（衣服）；给（动物）绝育
不及物动词：发生变化

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「改动；修改」，尤指改衣
由本词加形容词后缀 -able 构成，义为「可改变的」
由否定前缀 un- 加 alterable 构成，义为「无法改变的」
由拉丁语 alter 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「他者性；相异性」，多用于哲学与文化研究

senses.title: To make something different
senses.definition: to make a thing or a person different in some way, without replacing it with something else
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式使某物或某人变得不同，而不是把它整个换成别的东西
senses.example: Nothing can alter the fact that the deadline has already passed.
senses.exampleCN: 截止时间已经过去，这个事实无法改变。
senses.why: Latin alter means the other of two, so the verb first pictured making a thing into that other version of itself rather than swapping it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alter 意为「两者中的另一个」，动词最初想的正是把一样东西变成它自己的另一个版本，而不是换掉它，所以核心含义是「使不同」。

senses.title: To adjust a garment to fit
senses.definition: to take in, let out or otherwise adjust a piece of clothing so that it fits better
senses.definitionCN: 把衣物收进、放出或以其他方式调整，使其更合身
senses.example: The tailor altered the waist of the skirt in a single afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 裁缝一个下午就把裙子的腰身改好了。
senses.why: Cloth is the most concrete thing one can make other: the fabric stays, but its shape is turned into another fit.
senses.whyCN: 衣服是最具体的「把一样东西变成另一个样子」：布料还是那块布，形状却被改成另一种合身状态，所以裁缝的改动也用 alter。

senses.title: To become different
senses.definition: to change by itself over time, without any outside agent doing it
senses.definitionCN: 随时间自行改变，而不是由外部力量施加改动
senses.example: The town has altered little since the railway closed.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路停运以来，这座小镇几乎没有变化。
senses.why: Used without an object, the same pushing of a thing toward its other version lands on the subject itself.
senses.whyCN: 当动词不带宾语时，那股「把东西推向另一个版本」的力量就落在主语自己身上，于是从「改变别的东西」变成「自身发生变化」。

senses.title: A second self
senses.definition: in the phrase alter ego, a second self, a trusted other personality, or a role a person adopts
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 alter ego，指第二自我、可信赖的另一个人格，或一个人扮演的角色
senses.example: On stage he adopts an alter ego who is loud and fearless.
senses.exampleCN: 在舞台上他会变成另一个自我，嗓门很大，无所畏惧。
senses.why: Alter ego is Latin for other I, and the phrase keeps the original sense of the other one of a pair in its purest form.
senses.whyCN: alter ego 是拉丁语「另一个我」，把「两者中的另一个」这个本义原封不动地保留下来，所以指第二人格或另一个自己。

senses.title: To neuter an animal
senses.definition: to remove the reproductive organs of a pet or farm animal so that it cannot breed
senses.definitionCN: 切除宠物或家畜的生殖器官，使其不能繁殖
senses.example: The shelter alters every cat before it is offered for adoption.
senses.exampleCN: 收容所给每只猫做完绝育手术才让人领养。
senses.why: The animal's body is made into another state that cannot breed, which is the same core idea reaching a use far from tailoring.
senses.whyCN: 动物的身体被改造成另一种不能繁殖的状态，同一个核心意象延伸到一个与衣服无关的用途，这是美国英语里的常见说法。

intro.en: Alter came into English from Latin through French, and its oldest meaning is simply the other one of two.
intro.cn: alter 经法语从拉丁语进入英语，最古老的意思不过是「两者中的另一个」。

items.en: *h₂el- is generally reconstructed as meaning beyond or other; the same root is thought to lie behind Latin alius and English else.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *h₂el- 表示「在……之外、另一个」；拉丁语 alius 与英语 else 也一般认为出自这个词根。

items.en: Alter meant the other of two, as opposed to alius, which meant another among more than two.
items.cn: alter 意为「两者中的另一个」，与表示「两者以上之中的另一个」的 alius 相对。

items.en: Alter plus the verb ending -are gave alterare, to make different or change.
items.cn: alter 加上动词词尾 -are 构成 alterare，意为「使不同、改变」。

items.en: Old French alterer carried the verb into English; the medical and legal branches did not come with it.
items.cn: 古法语 alterer 把这个动词带入英语，医学与法律的分支并没有随之而来。

items.en: The tailoring sense is recorded in the nineteenth century, and alter ego was borrowed whole from Latin in the sixteenth; exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 改衣义在十九世纪有记录，alter ego 则在十六世纪整条短语从拉丁语借入；确切首见年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the Latin alter family and one phrase borrowed whole; the near-meaning group holds verbs of change with a narrower or broader reach.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语 alter 一族以及整条借入的短语；近义组收范围宽窄不一的「变化」类动词。

entries.definition: The noun for a change made to something, especially to a garment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「改动、修改」，尤指对衣物的修改。

entries.definition: Able to be changed; the opposite of fixed.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可改变的」，与「固定的」相对。

entries.definition: A second self or a trusted other personality, borrowed whole from Latin.
entries.definitionCN: 名词短语，义为「另一个自我、第二人格」，整条从拉丁语借入。

entries.definition: Not changed at all, still in the original state.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「未改变的、原样的」。

entries.definition: The general verb for becoming or making different; broader and far more common than alter.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「改变、变化」，是最一般的说法，比 alter 更宽也更常用。

entries.definition: To change something slightly, usually to improve it or make it suitable.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「修改、调整」，通常指小幅改动以改进或使其适用。

entries.definition: To change a text, law or agreement in order to correct or improve it.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「修订、修正」，多用于文本、法律或协议。

entries.definition: To change something slightly so that it fits or works better.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「调整」，指小幅改动以更合适或更好用。

entries.definition: To change or differ, especially in amount or degree over time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「变化、使有差异」，多指数量或程度随时间变动。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin sense of alter and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用 alter 真实的拉丁语本义，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Latin alter means the other of two: to alter is to turn a thing into that other version.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 alter 意为「两者中的另一个」：alter 就是把东西变成那另一个版本。

normal.en: Alter ego is literally other I, the same alter followed by a different noun.
normal.cn: alter ego 字面就是「另一个我」，用的正是同一个 alter 加另一个名词。

normal.en: A tailor alters clothes: the cloth stays, only its shape becomes other.
normal.cn: 裁缝 alter 衣服：布料不变，只有形状变成另一个样子。

normal.en: Unaltered and alteration keep the same root, one with a negative prefix and one with a noun ending.
normal.cn: unaltered 与 alteration 都保留同一词根，一个加否定前缀，一个加名词词尾。

normal.en: Alter is more formal than change and usually takes a direct object.
normal.cn: alter 比 change 更正式，而且通常直接带宾语。

abstract.en: Picture a mirror showing the same coat with a different cut: one cloth, two shapes.
abstract.cn: 想象一面镜子照出同一件大衣的另一种剪裁：布只有一块，形状却有两个。

abstract.en: Alter is a small turn of the same object, not a swap for a new one.
abstract.cn: alter 是同一件东西的小幅转向，而不是换成一件新的。

abstract.en: The other of two is the whole idea: first there is a thing, then its other version.
abstract.cn: 「两者中的另一个」就是全部意思：先有一样东西，再有它的另一个版本。

examples.en: A few small repairs would alter the look of the room without much cost.
examples.cn: 几处小修补就能改变房间的样子，花费并不多。

examples.en: The dress was altered twice before the wedding.
examples.cn: 这条裙子在婚礼前改了两次。

examples.en: His public manner is calm, but his alter ego on stage is wild.
examples.cn: 他在人前举止平静，舞台上的另一个自我却很狂放。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特」——奥特曼换了个形态，还是同一个，只是变成另一个样子：改变

root: 拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」来自原始印欧语 *h₂el-「在……之外、另一个」（重构形式）；加动词词尾 -are 成 alterare「使不同、改变」，经古法语 alterer 进入英语。alter ego 是十六世纪整条借入的拉丁语短语。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of alter all start from the other of two: changing a thing, adjusting a garment, changing by itself, a second self, and a neutered animal.
sensesIntro.cn: alter 的五个义项都从「两者中的另一个」出发：改变事物、改衣、自身变化、另一个自我，以及给动物绝育。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tailor's chalk line redraws an old coat into another shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：裁缝的粉线在旧大衣上重新划过，把它改成另一个样子。

branches.en: THE OBJECT: an outside hand makes a thing into another version of itself.
branches.cn: 对象线：外来的手把一样东西变成它自己的另一个版本。

branches.en: THE GARMENT: cloth is refitted, so the change is physical and small.
branches.cn: 衣物线：布料被重新剪裁，改动具体而幅度有限。

branches.en: THE SUBJECT: without an object, the same change happens inside the thing itself.
branches.cn: 主体线：不带宾语时，同样的变化发生在事物自身之内。

branches.en: THE SECOND SELF: alter ego keeps the Latin phrase and its logic of a pair.
branches.cn: 第二自我线：alter ego 保留拉丁原语，也保留「成对」的逻辑。

branches.en: THE BODY: an animal is made into a non-breeding body, the furthest reach of the same idea.
branches.cn: 身体线：动物被改成不再繁殖的身体，是同一想法延伸得最远的一端。

intro.en: Alter is a Latin comparative word rather than a prefix; the English family is built with ordinary Latin and English endings.
intro.cn: alter 是拉丁语的比较级形式，并不是前缀；英语这一族词靠普通的拉丁语与英语词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin alter, alius, alterare and alteratio are all recorded, so only the Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 alter、alius、alterare、alteratio 都有文献记录，只有印欧语词根属于重构形式。

items.example: The base carries the idea of a second version.
items.exampleCN: 这个词基承载「另一个版本」的意思。

items.example: The ending is generally analysed as making alter a comparative form.
items.exampleCN: 一般认为这个词尾使 alter 成为比较级形式。

items.example: It forms alterare.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alterare。

items.example: It forms alteration.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alteration。

items.example: It forms alterable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alterable。

items.example: It forms unaltered.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 unaltered。

items.example: It forms altered.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 altered。

items.example: It forms altering.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 altering。

items.example: It forms alter ego, a second self.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alter ego，即另一个自我。

latinEntries.meaning: other, another of more than two
latinEntries.meaningCN: 别的；两者以上之中的另一个

definition_zh: 可供选择的方案；替代品；可供选择的；非传统的；另类的
definition_en: one of two or more possible choices, something used in place of another, or an adjective describing an option outside the usual course
core_image: 岔路口立着两块路牌，一块是常走的路，另一块是另一条
scene: 会议桌上摊着两份预算，一份保守，一份激进。The board rejected the first plan and asked for an alternative.
sceneCN: 这里 alternative 是「替代方案」（第 2 个义项：可以顶替原有做法的事物）；句意为董事会否决了第一份方案，要求另提一个方案。画面里是摊开的预算表与两支笔。

pos.zh: 名词：可供选择的方案；替代品；备选项
形容词：可供选择的；替代的；非传统的；另类的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「或者；作为另一种选择」
由同一拉丁词根 alternare 构成，义为「交替、轮流」，作形容词时义为「间隔的」
由 alternare 加名词后缀 -ion 构成，义为「交替、轮换」
由 alternare 加表施动者的后缀 -or 构成，义为「交流发电机」

senses.title: One of two or more possible choices
senses.definition: one of the things you can choose between when a decision has to be made
senses.definitionCN: 必须作出决定时，可供你在其中挑选的若干事物之一
senses.example: We weighed two alternatives for a week before signing the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 签约前我们用了一周时间权衡两个方案。
senses.why: The word is built on Latin alter, the other of two, so the noun names the other item lying on the table beside the first.
senses.whyCN: 这个词建立在拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」之上，所以名词指的就是摆在第一个选项旁边的那「另一个」，即选项之一。

senses.title: A thing used instead of another
senses.definition: something that can take the place of the thing normally used
senses.definitionCN: 能够占据平时所用之物位置的东西
senses.example: For many commuters the bicycle is a cheap alternative to the car.
senses.exampleCN: 对许多通勤者来说，自行车是汽车的廉价替代品。
senses.why: Once an item is the other one of the pair, it can occupy the first one's place, and substitution is that pairing image put into action.
senses.whyCN: 一项东西既然是成对里的「另一个」，就能占据第一个的位置；替代义正是把「成对」的画面变成实际行动。

senses.title: Another possibility offered as a choice
senses.definition: used about a plan, route or method that can be chosen instead of the usual one
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述可以代替常规做法被选中的计划、路线或方法
senses.example: The airline put us on an alternative flight the next morning.
senses.exampleCN: 航空公司把我们安排到了第二天早上的另一趟航班。
senses.why: As an adjective the word simply marks the second item before the noun and leaves the choosing to the reader.
senses.whyCN: 作形容词时，这个词只是把「第二个」这个身份贴到名词前面，把选择留给读者去做，所以译作「备选的」。

senses.title: Outside the mainstream
senses.definition: describing a treatment, energy source or way of living that differs from the conventional one
senses.definitionCN: 描述不同于常规做法的疗法、能源或生活方式
senses.example: The clinic is known for alternative treatments that avoid strong drugs.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所以不用强效药物的另类疗法闻名。
senses.why: Once the pair becomes mainstream versus other, the second item stops being neutral and takes on the colour of dissent.
senses.whyCN: 当这对选项变成「主流与另一个」时，第二个就不再中性，而带上了不从众的色彩，于是成了「非传统」的标签。

senses.title: No alternative but to
senses.definition: in the phrase have no alternative but to, to be forced into one course because nothing else is open
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 have no alternative but to，表示因别无他路而被迫走某一条路
senses.example: With the bridge closed, drivers had no alternative but to take the long road.
senses.exampleCN: 桥封了，司机们别无选择，只能绕远路。
senses.why: The pair collapses into a single option: when the other one does not exist, what remains is not really a choice at all.
senses.whyCN: 成对的选项塌缩成一个：当「另一个」根本不存在时，剩下的那条路其实算不上选择，于是这个短语表示「只能如此」。

intro.en: Alternative is the Latin alter family again, this time carried through a verb and an adjective ending.
intro.cn: alternative 仍是拉丁语 alter 一族，只是这回经过一个动词和一个形容词词尾。

items.en: Alter meant the other of two and is the base of the whole family.
items.cn: alter 意为「两者中的另一个」，是整个词族的基础。

items.en: Alter plus an adjective ending gave alternus, one after the other or alternate.
items.cn: alter 加形容词词尾构成 alternus，意为「轮流、交替的」。

items.en: The verb alternare meant to do by turns; English alternate comes from the same verb.
items.cn: 动词 alternare 意为「轮流、交替做」，英语 alternate 出自同一个动词。

items.en: Medieval Latin alternativus, forming a choice between two, passed through French alternatif into English.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 alternativus 意为「构成二选一的」，经法语 alternatif 进入英语。

items.en: The noun sense one of two courses is recorded from the seventeenth century, while the unconventional sense belongs to the twentieth; exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 名词义「两条路中的一条」自十七世纪有记录，「非传统」义则属于二十世纪；确切年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on the same Latin alternus root; the near-meaning group holds words for choices and stand-ins.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁语 alternus 词根构成的词；近义组收表示「选择」与「顶替」的词。

entries.definition: To take turns, or an adjective for every other one in a series.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「交替、轮流」；作形容词时义为「间隔的、隔一个的」。

entries.definition: In turns, one after the other.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「交替地、轮流地」，由 alternate 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of taking turns or changing repeatedly between two states.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交替、轮换」，指在两种状态之间反复更换。

entries.definition: A machine that produces alternating current.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交流发电机」，指产生交变电流的机器。

entries.definition: As another possibility; used to introduce a second option in writing.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「或者、作为另一种选择」，在书面语中引出第二个选项。

entries.definition: A thing that may be chosen; neutral in tone and common in business and law.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「选项、选择权」，语气中性，常见于商务与法律语境。

entries.definition: The range of things to choose from, or the act of choosing; broader than alternative.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「选择、可供选择的范围」，范围比 alternative 更宽。

entries.definition: A person or thing that takes the place of another, often with no sense of choice.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「替代者、代替物」，通常不带「可供选择」的意味。

entries.definition: A reserve option kept ready in case the first one fails.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「后备、备用方案」，指为防第一个失效而预留的选择。

entries.definition: Something that fills the place of a thing that has gone or been used up.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「替换物」，指填补已消失或用尽之物位置的东西。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Latin alter base and the real phrases the word forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用 alter 这个拉丁语词基，以及这个词真实构成的搭配。

normal.en: Alter is the other of two, so an alternative is that other one offered as a choice.
normal.cn: alter 是「两者中的另一个」，所以 alternative 就是被摆出来供人挑选的那「另一个」。

normal.en: The ending -ive keeps the word adjectival, so it can stand before a noun: an alternative plan.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ive 让它保持形容词性质，可以放在名词前：an alternative plan。

normal.en: Have no alternative but to marks the moment the pair of options shrinks to one.
normal.cn: have no alternative but to 标记的正是成对选项缩成一个的时刻。

normal.en: Alternative medicine is simply the other route beside mainstream medicine.
normal.cn: alternative medicine 不过是主流医学旁边的另一条路。

normal.en: Alternative and alternate differ by one ending: a choice versus taking turns.
normal.cn: alternative 与 alternate 只差一个词尾：一个是可选项，一个是轮流。

abstract.en: Picture two signposts at a fork: one points to the usual road, the other is blank until you name it.
abstract.cn: 想象岔路口的两块路牌：一块指向常走的路，另一块在你给它命名之前是空白的。

abstract.en: The blank sign is not a worse road, only a road you have not taken yet.
abstract.cn: 那块空白路牌并不代表更差的路，只是一条你还没走过的路。

abstract.en: When the usual sign falls down, the blank one is all that is left, which is why the word also means the only way out.
abstract.cn: 当常走的那块牌子倒下，空白的这块就成了唯一剩下的一条，这正是该词也表「唯一出路」的原因。

examples.en: Cycling is a healthy alternative to driving for short trips.
examples.cn: 短途出行时，骑车是比开车更健康的替代方式。

examples.en: The committee could see no alternative to closing the library on Sundays.
examples.cn: 委员会看不出除了周日关闭图书馆之外还有别的办法。

examples.en: She avoids sugar and uses honey as an alternative sweetener.
examples.cn: 她不吃糖，改用蜂蜜作为替代甜味剂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特纳提夫」——奥特曼站在岔路口，总得挑另一个方案：替代方案

root: 拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」加形容词词尾构成 alternus「交替的」，再加动词词尾 -are 成 alternare「轮流做」；中世纪拉丁语 alternativus「构成二选一的」经法语 alternatif 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of alternative all come from the paired option: a possible choice, a stand-in, an available second option, a route outside the mainstream, and the phrase for having no other route at all.
sensesIntro.cn: alternative 的五个义项都来自「成对的选项」：可选项、替代品、备选项、主流之外的路线，以及表示再无他路可走的固定说法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two signposts stand at a fork, one for the usual road and one for its other.
core.cn: 核心意象：岔路口立着两块路牌，一块指向常走的路，一块指向它的另一条。

branches.en: THE CHOICE: the second signpost is simply one of the things you may pick.
branches.cn: 选择线：第二块路牌只是你可以挑选的事物之一。

branches.en: THE STAND-IN: the second thing can take the first one's place.
branches.cn: 替换线：第二个东西可以占据第一个的位置。

branches.en: THE LABEL: placed before a noun, the word marks an option rather than naming one.
branches.cn: 标签线：放在名词前时，这个词只标记「备选」，而不指认具体某一条。

branches.en: THE DISSENT: once the pair is mainstream versus other, the other side carries a flavour of refusal.
branches.cn: 异见线：一旦这对变成「主流与另一个」，另一侧就带上了拒斥常规的意味。

branches.en: THE DEAD END: with the other signpost gone, the word turns into the phrase for having no choice.
branches.cn: 绝路线：另一块路牌不在了，这个词就转为表示「别无选择」的说法。

intro.en: Alternative is built from the Latin base alter plus a verb ending and an adjective suffix; English adds ordinary endings to grow the family.
intro.cn: alternative 由拉丁语词基 alter 加动词词尾和形容词后缀构成；英语再用普通词尾扩展这一族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin alter, alternus, alternare and alternativus are all recorded, so only the Indo-European root behind alter is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 alter、alternus、alternare、alternativus 都有文献记录，只有 alter 背后的印欧语词根属于重构形式。

definition_zh: 虽然；尽管；不过；然而
definition_en: used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main statement, or to add a qualification that weakens what has just been said
core_image: 先点头让一步，再把话拉回来：一边承认，一边不被它挡住
scene: 雨下了一整夜，院子里的木凳全湿透了。Although the bench was soaked, the old man sat down and began to read.
sceneCN: 这里 although 是「虽然」（第 1 个义项：在句首先让一步，再给出主句）；句意为尽管长凳湿透了，老人还是坐下来开始看书。画面里是湿木凳与摊开的书。

pos.zh: 连词：虽然；尽管；不过；然而

derivatives.zh: 构成本词后半部分的来源词，也是更口语的同义连词，可置于句末
本词的非正式书面拼写变体，常见于随笔与歌词，并非新造派生词
在 though 前加 even 构成的短语，让步语气比 although 更强

senses.title: Despite the fact that
senses.definition: used at the beginning of a clause to admit a fact that makes the main clause surprising
senses.definitionCN: 用于从句开头，先承认一个会让主句显得意外的事实
senses.example: Although the road was icy, she drove home without any trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管路面结了冰，她还是平安开回了家。
senses.why: The word is a compound of all and though, so it grants the whole of the opposing fact before the main clause goes on.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 all 与 though 的复合，先把对方的事实「整个」承认下来，主句才继续往下说，所以让步语气完整而正式。

senses.title: But, after the main clause
senses.definition: used after the main statement to add a fact that limits or corrects it
senses.definitionCN: 用在主句之后，补上一个限制或修正前面说法的事实
senses.example: He agreed to help, although he had very little time.
senses.exampleCN: 他答应帮忙，不过他时间很少。
senses.why: When the concession comes second, the admitted fact works backwards on what was just said, and the word behaves like but.
senses.whyCN: 当让步放在后面时，被承认的事实反过来削弱前面刚说的话，于是这个词的作用接近 but，译作「不过」。

senses.title: Although with yet or still
senses.titleCN: 尽管……却（与 yet 或 still 呼应）
senses.definition: used with yet or still in the main clause to stress the contrast, chiefly in formal writing
senses.definitionCN: 主句中与 yet 或 still 呼应，以加重对比，主要用于正式书面语
senses.example: Although the evidence was thin, the jury still returned a guilty verdict.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管证据薄弱，陪审团仍然作出了有罪裁决。
senses.why: An old habit of English pairs a concessive clause with yet or still; the two markers together make the contrast heavier.
senses.whyCN: 英语有一个老习惯：让步从句常与 yet 或 still 呼应，两个标记一起用，对比就更重，语气也更书面。

senses.title: However, standing alone in speech
senses.titleCN: 不过（口语中单独成句补充）
senses.definition: used alone at the start of a spoken sentence to add a qualification, roughly like however
senses.definitionCN: 在口语里单独放在句首，补充一点修正，作用大致相当于 however
senses.example: I like the flat. Although, the neighbours are rather loud.
senses.exampleCN: 我喜欢这套房子。不过，邻居挺吵的。
senses.why: Speech often adds a late correction; the word then detaches from its clause and keeps only the turning function.
senses.whyCN: 口语常在说完之后再补一个修正，这个词于是从句子里脱离出来，只留下「转折」这一功能，相当于 however。

intro.en: Although is a native English compound, literally all though, and it has meant even though from its earliest records.
intro.cn: although 是英语本族语的复合词，字面就是 all though，从最早记录起就表示「even though」。

items.en: *þauh is the reconstructed form behind the though element; the deeper origin of this word is source uncertain.
items.cn: 重构形式 *þauh 是 though 这一成分的来源；这个词更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Eall meant all or entirely, and þēah meant though; the two already stood side by side with eall acting as an intensifier.
items.cn: eall 意为「全部、完全」，þēah 意为「虽然」；两者早已并排使用，eall 起加强语气的作用。

items.en: The pair was written al thogh or al thaugh as two words, with al the Middle English form of eall.
items.cn: 这一对词在中古英语里写作 al thogh 或 al thaugh，分成两个词，其中 al 是 eall 的中古英语形式。

items.en: The two words merged into one spelling, although; the shorter altho appears later as an informal written form, and exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 两个词合并成一个拼写 although；较短的 altho 后来作为非正式书面形式出现，确切年代不确定。

items.en: Although became the formal concessive, while though stayed the everyday form and can also end a sentence.
items.cn: although 成为正式的让步连词，though 则留在日常口语里，还可以放在句末。

note.en: The look-alike group holds forms built from the same though element; the near-meaning group holds other words that mark contrast.
note.cn: 形近组收由同一个 though 成分构成的词；近义组收其他表示对比转折的词。

entries.definition: The shorter, more conversational concessive that forms the second half of although.
entries.definitionCN: 更短、更口语的让步连词，正是 although 的后半部分。

entries.definition: A stronger concessive phrase used when the contrast is emphatic.
entries.definitionCN: 让步语气更强的短语，用于对比需要强调时。

entries.definition: A phrase meaning as if; it uses the same though element but makes a comparison, not a concession.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「好像、仿佛」，用同一个 though 成分，但表示比较而非让步。

entries.definition: A shortened written spelling of although found in notes, songs and informal prose.
entries.definitionCN: although 的缩短拼写，见于随笔、歌词与非正式文章。

entries.definition: A preposition meaning in spite of; it takes a noun or a gerund, not a clause.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「尽管」，后面接名词或动名词，不能接从句。

entries.definition: A prepositional phrase with the same meaning as despite, slightly longer in form.
entries.definitionCN: 介词短语，意思与 despite 相同，形式上更长一些。

entries.definition: A formal conjunction that sets two facts side by side in contrast rather than conceding one.
entries.definitionCN: 正式连词，把两个事实并置对比，而不是让一步承认其中之一。

entries.definition: A conjunction that can mark contrast, though it also carries a time meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，可以表示对比，但同时带有「当……时」的时间义。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in spite of that; it marks the main clause rather than the admitted fact.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「尽管如此」，标记的是主句而不是被承认的事实。

normalIntro.en: These hooks work with the two halves of the compound and with careful-writing habits.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子利用这个复合词的两个部分，以及书面语里的使用习惯。

normal.en: Although is all plus though: the whole of the opposing fact is granted first.
normal.cn: although 是 all 加 though：先把对方的事实整个承认下来。

normal.en: Split it as al plus though and the force of even though becomes visible.
normal.cn: 把它拆成 al 加 though，就能看出「even though」的那股力气。

normal.en: Although belongs to formal writing; though is what people actually say, and it can end a sentence.
normal.cn: although 偏书面；though 才是人们口里说的，而且可以放在句末。

normal.en: After the main clause, although works like but: he agreed, although he was busy.
normal.cn: 放在主句之后，although 的作用就像 but：他答应了，尽管他很忙。

normal.en: In careful writing, although is not followed by but in the same sentence.
normal.cn: 在严谨的写作里，although 与 but 不在同一句中重复使用。

abstract.en: Picture a door held open for the opposing fact, then the speaker walking on past it.
abstract.cn: 想象为对方的事实把门推开，说话人却从那扇门旁继续往前走。

abstract.en: The concession is not a surrender: it is a step to the side, not a stop.
abstract.cn: 让步不是投降：它只是往旁边让一步，而不是停下。

abstract.en: All of the fact is admitted, and none of the main point is given up.
abstract.cn: 事实被整块承认下来，主要观点却一点也没有让出。

examples.en: Although the shop was small, it carried an impressive range of tools.
examples.cn: 这家店虽然小，工具种类却多得惊人。

examples.en: The results were useful, although the sample was too small to prove much.
examples.cn: 结果有用，不过样本太小，证明不了什么。

examples.en: Although he had rehearsed for weeks, his hands still shook at the piano.
examples.cn: 尽管排练了好几周，他坐在钢琴前手还是发抖。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥搜」——先「哦」一声承认，再说「虽然」：让一步再往下讲

root: 由中古英语 al（all 的弱化形式，作加强语气，义近「即使、全然」）与 though（古英语 þēah）复合而成，字面即「even though」；两部分在十四至十六世纪逐渐写成一个词。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of although all perform one move, granting a fact before or after the main point: initial concession, a but-like tail, the yet pattern, and the spoken standalone however.
sensesIntro.cn: although 的四个义项都在做同一个动作——在主句之前或之后承认一个事实：句首让步、句末的「不过」、与 yet 呼应的结构，以及口语里单独成句的 however。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand lifts in admission while the feet keep walking forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手抬起来表示承认，脚却继续往前走。

branches.en: THE OPENING: the admitted fact comes first, so the main clause lands with contrast.
branches.cn: 句首线：被承认的事实先说，主句落下时就带上了对比。

branches.en: THE TAIL: the admitted fact comes second and pulls back on what was just claimed.
branches.cn: 句末线：被承认的事实后置，把刚说过的说法往回拉一点。

branches.en: THE PAIRING: with yet or still in the main clause, the contrast is pressed harder.
branches.cn: 呼应对：主句里再加 yet 或 still，对比就被压得更重。

branches.en: THE DETACHED TURN: in speech the word can stand alone and keep only the turning force.
branches.cn: 独立转折：口语里这个词可以单独站着，只保留转折的力道。

branches.en: THE REGISTER: sense 01 keeps the word formal, while sense 04 shows how far speech lets it stand alone.
branches.cn: 语体线：第 1 个义项让这个词保持正式，第 4 个义项则显示口语允许它独立到什么程度。

intro.en: Although is not built from a prefix and a root but from two whole words fused; its parts are still visible in the spelling.
intro.cn: although 不是由前缀加词根构成，而是两个完整的词融合而成；两部分在拼写里仍然看得见。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic, with no Latin ancestor, so there are no Latin cognates to list here.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属于日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖形，因此没有可列的拉丁同源词。

items.meaning: all, wholly, used as an intensifier
items.meaningCN: 全部；完全，用作加强语气
items.example: In although it adds the sense of even.
items.exampleCN: 在 although 里它添上「即使、连……也」的语气。

items.example: The first element descends from this word.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分就来自这个词。

items.example: It is the second half of although.
items.exampleCN: 它是 although 的后半部分。

items.example: The two parts fused into one word.
items.exampleCN: 两个部分合成了一个词。

items.example: It forms even though.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 even though。

items.meaning: despite the fact that, with stronger force
items.example: It is close in meaning to although.
items.exampleCN: 它的意思接近 although。

items.example: It uses the same though element.
items.exampleCN: 它用的是同一个 though 成分。

items.meaning: an informal written form of although
items.meaningCN: although 的非正式书面拼写
items.example: It appears in notes and songs.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在随笔与歌词里。

definition_zh: 完全地；全然；总共；合计；总而言之
definition_en: completely, with everything counted, or when the whole situation is considered
core_image: 把散落的东西全部拢到一处，堆成一个整体
scene: 搬家那天，纸箱从楼上一直堆到门口。There were eleven boxes altogether, and not one of them was labelled.
sceneCN: 这里 altogether 是「总共」（第 2 个义项：把各项加在一起来算）；句意为总共有十一个箱子，而且一个都没有贴标签。画面里是堆到门口的纸箱。

pos.zh: 副词：完全地；总共；总而言之

derivatives.zh: 本词的后半部分，来自古英语 tōgædere，是同源成分而非由本词派生
分开写的短语，义为「大家一起」，与本词的单字拼写形成对照，并非派生词

senses.title: Completely, entirely
senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is entirely the case, with no exception or reserve
senses.definitionCN: 用来强调某事完全如此，没有例外也没有保留
senses.example: The mood in the room was altogether different after the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到消息后，屋里的气氛完全不同了。
senses.why: Together gathers things into one place and all adds completeness, so the whole is entirely one thing with nothing left out.
senses.whyCN: together 把东西收到一处，all 又添上「全部」，合起来就是整体上一点不剩，于是表示「完全地」。

senses.title: In total, counting everything
senses.definition: when everything is counted or included, with nothing omitted from the sum
senses.definitionCN: 把所有东西都算进去、一点也不漏时的总数
senses.example: The trip cost us about two thousand yuan altogether.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行我们总共花了大约两千元。
senses.why: Count items into one heap, and the adverb answers the question of how many there are in all.
senses.whyCN: 把一项项数进同一堆里，这个副词回答的就是「加起来一共多少」，所以表示「总共」。

senses.title: On the whole
senses.definition: used when a judgment is made about a whole situation after everything has been considered
senses.definitionCN: 把各方面都考虑过之后，对整个局面作出判断时使用
senses.example: Altogether, it was a difficult year but a useful one.
senses.exampleCN: 总的来说，这是艰难的一年，也是有收获的一年。
senses.why: Look at the heap as one object instead of as separate parts, and the adverb turns into a summary judgment.
senses.whyCN: 不去看堆里的每一件，而是把整堆当成一个对象来看，这个副词就从「合计」转为对整个局面的总结。

senses.title: In the altogether
senses.definition: in the informal phrase in the altogether, wearing no clothes at all
senses.definitionCN: 用于非正式短语 in the altogether，表示身上什么衣服都没穿
senses.example: The toddler escaped from the bath and ran through the hall in the altogether.
senses.exampleCN: 那孩子从浴缸里跑出来，光着身子穿过走廊。
senses.why: The whole body is taken as one undivided whole, and the phrase becomes a playful way of saying naked.
senses.whyCN: 把整个身体当作一个不可分割的整体，这个短语就成了「一丝不挂」的委婉而带玩笑味的说法。

intro.en: Altogether is a native compound of all and together, two words that were later written as one.
intro.cn: altogether 是 all 与 together 的本族语复合词，原本是两个词，后来写成了一个。

items.en: Eall meant all, and tōgædere meant in one company; the ancestor of together already carried the idea of gathering into one place.
items.cn: eall 意为「全部」，tōgædere 意为「聚在一处」；together 的祖形已经带有「收拢到一处」的意思。

items.en: Al together was still written as two words and meant both all in one group and in total.
items.cn: al together 仍写作两个词，既表示「大家聚在一处」，也表示「合计」。

items.en: The two words merged into the single spelling altogether, while the group sense was increasingly written all together; exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 两个词合并成单字拼写 altogether，「聚在一处」的意思则越来越多写作 all together；确切年代不确定。

items.en: In emphatic use the sense in total shaded into entirely, and the completive meaning became established.
items.cn: 在强调用法里，「合计」的意思逐渐滑向「全然」，表示「完全」的用法就此确立。

items.en: The phrase in the altogether for being naked is recorded in the nineteenth century, and careful writing keeps all together for the group sense.
items.cn: 表示赤身裸体的短语 in the altogether 在十九世纪有记录；严谨的写作仍用分开的 all together 表示「聚在一起」。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on together and the easily confused two-word phrase; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of completeness and summing up.
note.cn: 形近组收由 together 构成的词以及容易混淆的分写短语；近义组收表示「完全」与「总括」的副词。

entries.definition: In one place or group, with others; the second half of altogether.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「一起、共同」，是 altogether 的后半部分。

entries.definition: A two-word phrase meaning everyone in one group; it looks like altogether but has a different meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 分开写的短语，义为「大家聚在一起」；它看起来像 altogether，意思却不同。

entries.definition: The noun for the feeling of closeness within a group.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「团聚感、亲密无间」，由 together 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: To the fullest degree, with nothing missing; the most neutral of the completive adverbs.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，是这类副词里最中性的一个。

entries.definition: Wholly, as a single undivided whole.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「整个地、全然」，强调作为一个不可分割的整体。

entries.definition: Completely, often in formal or legal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，多用于正式或法律文本。

entries.definition: Considering everything; a summary view that keeps the parts in sight.
entries.definitionCN: 副词或形容词，义为「总体上」，是仍看得见各部分的总结视角。

entries.definition: Completely, common in speech and often emphatic.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，口语常用，语气往往更强。

normalIntro.en: These hooks pull the compound apart and use the phrases that keep the word alive.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把这个复合词拆开，并利用让它保持活力的几个搭配。

normal.en: Break it as all plus together: everything gathered, nothing left out.
normal.cn: 把它拆成 all 加 together：东西全拢在一起，一件也没落下。

normal.en: Together is the second half, so the word still pictures things in one heap.
normal.cn: 后半部分是 together，所以这个词仍然画着「东西堆成一堆」的画面。

normal.en: Altogether different means completely different, not all together in one place.
normal.cn: altogether different 意为「完全不同」，不是「全都在一处」。

normal.en: Written apart, all together means everyone in one group; written as one word, altogether means completely or in total.
normal.cn: 分开写 all together 指大家聚在一起；写成一个词 altogether 则表示完全或总共。

normal.en: In the altogether is a set phrase for having no clothes on.
normal.cn: in the altogether 是一个固定短语，指身上没穿衣服。

abstract.en: Picture scattered boxes pushed with a broom into one pile against the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象用扫帚把散落的箱子一路推到墙边，堆成一堆。

abstract.en: Once they are one pile, you can count them, and you can also step back and judge the pile as a whole.
abstract.cn: 堆成一堆之后，你既能数清它们，也能退后一步对整堆作出评价。

abstract.en: The same heap read as a quantity gives in total, and read as a shape gives completely.
abstract.cn: 同一堆东西，当作数量来读就是「总共」，当作一个形态来读就是「完全」。

examples.en: The two sisters look altogether different, yet their voices are alike.
examples.cn: 姐妹俩看起来完全不同，声音却很像。

examples.en: Altogether, the repairs will take about three weeks.
examples.cn: 总共算下来，维修大约要三周。

examples.en: It was not altogether a failure, though little of the plan survived.
examples.cn: 这并不完全是失败，尽管计划几乎没剩下什么。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥拓盖德」——把东西全扫成一堆再数：总共、完全

root: 由 all 与 together 复合而成，中古英语写作 al together 两个词；together 来自古英语 tōgædere，其中 to- 表「到、向」，gædere 表「聚在一处」。合写后兼有「总共」与「完全」两义，而「大家一起」仍写作 all together。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of altogether move from one heap to a judgment: entirely, in total, on the whole, and the fixed phrase for being naked.
sensesIntro.cn: altogether 的四个义项都围绕「一堆」展开：完全地、总共、总而言之，以及表示赤身裸体的固定说法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: everything scattered is swept into one pile against the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：散落的东西被扫到墙边，拢成一堆。

branches.en: THE WHOLE: the pile is viewed as one undivided thing, so nothing is excepted.
branches.cn: 整体线：把整堆看成一个不可分割的东西，所以一点例外都没有。

branches.en: THE COUNT: the same pile is counted item by item, and the adverb gives the sum.
branches.cn: 计数线：同一堆东西逐件来数，这个副词给出的就是总数。

branches.en: THE JUDGMENT: stepping back from the pile turns the sum into a verdict on the whole.
branches.cn: 评判线：从堆边退后一步，总数就变成了对整个局面的评语。

branches.en: THE BODY: the whole body taken as one unit gives the playful phrase for naked.
branches.cn: 身体线：把整个身体当成一个单位，就有了「一丝不挂」那个玩笑式的说法。

branches.en: THE COUNTERPART: the two-word all together keeps the group sense, so the single word now reads mainly as a sum or a verdict.
branches.cn: 对照线：分开写的 all together 保留了「聚在一起」的意思，单字拼写的本词于是主要读作合计或评语。

intro.en: Altogether is a native compound, so its parts are whole Old English words rather than prefixes and roots.
intro.cn: altogether 是本族语复合词，它的组成部分是完整的古英语词，而不是前缀与词根。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are Germanic, with no Latin ancestor, so no Latin cognates are listed.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部分都属于日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖形，因此不列拉丁同源词。

items.example: It is the first part of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个复合词的第一部分。

items.example: It is the shape the first element took in Middle English.
items.exampleCN: 这是第一个成分在中古英语里的形态。

items.example: It is the second part of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个复合词的第二部分。

items.example: It is the first element of tōgædere.
items.exampleCN: 它是 tōgædere 的第一个成分。

items.example: It is the second element of tōgædere.
items.exampleCN: 它是 tōgædere 的第二个成分。

items.example: It forms togetherness.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 togetherness。

items.example: The two words fused into one spelling.
items.exampleCN: 两个词融合成一个拼写。

items.example: It keeps the group sense that the single word lost.
items.exampleCN: 它保留了单字拼写丢掉的那层「聚在一起」的意思。

definition_zh: 总是；一直；永远；始终；老是
definition_en: on every occasion, for all time, or again and again in a way that annoys the speaker
core_image: 一条没有断点的线，从开头一直画到尽头
scene: 老人每天清晨都在同一个路口等公交车。He has always caught the same bus at the same corner.
sceneCN: 这里 always 是「一直、总是」（第 1 个义项：每次都如此，从不例外）；句意为他一直都在同一个街角坐同一班公交。画面里是清晨的路口与站牌。

pos.zh: 副词：总是；一直；永远；老是

derivatives.zh: 本词较早的形式，今多见于诗歌，并非新派生词
分开写的短语，义为「在各方面」，与本词拼写相近但意思不同

senses.title: On every occasion
senses.definition: on every occasion, without exception, as a regular pattern
senses.definitionCN: 每一次都如此，没有例外，形成规律
senses.example: She always arrives ten minutes before the shop opens.
senses.exampleCN: 她总是在店开门前十分钟到。
senses.why: Old English ealne weg meant all the way; a road with no break in it became the picture of an action that never misses.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ealne weg 意为「全程、整条路」，一条没有断点的路，就成了「每次都不缺」这个意思的画面。

senses.title: For ever, for all time
senses.definition: for all time, with no end point, whether looking forward or back
senses.definitionCN: 在时间上没有终点，无论向前看还是向后看
senses.example: I will always remember the smell of that kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 我会永远记得那间厨房的味道。
senses.why: If the road runs to the end, the action has no stopping point in time, so the same line stretches without limit.
senses.whyCN: 如果这条路一直通到尽头，动作在时间上就没有停止点，同一条线于是无限延伸，所以表示「永远」。

senses.title: Again and again, to the speaker's annoyance
senses.titleCN: 老是；没完没了地（含抱怨）
senses.definition: used with a progressive verb to complain about a habit that keeps repeating
senses.definitionCN: 与进行时连用，抱怨一个一再重复的习惯
senses.example: He is always leaving his mug on the edge of the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 他老是把杯子搁在桌沿上。
senses.why: The same unbroken line, seen from the annoyed side, becomes a pattern that keeps coming back when you wish it would stop.
senses.whyCN: 同一条不断的线，从厌烦的一面看，就成了「你希望它停下却一再出现」的模式，于是带出抱怨口气。

senses.title: There is always another way
senses.titleCN: 总还可以；至少可以（提建议）
senses.definition: used in suggestions to point out that one more option remains open
senses.definitionCN: 在建议中用来指出总还有一条路可走
senses.example: If the train is full, you can always take the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 要是火车满了，你总还可以坐公交。
senses.why: If a road is open at every moment, there is always one more route to fall back on, so the word turns into an offer of a remaining option.
senses.whyCN: 如果一条路在任何时刻都通着，就总有另一条可以退回去走，于是这个词在建议里表示「总还有这个办法」。

senses.title: As always, in the usual way
senses.definition: in the fixed phrase as always, in the same way as on every previous occasion
senses.definitionCN: 用于固定短语 as always，表示与以往每一次一样
senses.example: As always, she brought a notebook and wrote everything down.
senses.exampleCN: 她一如既往地带着笔记本，把一切都记了下来。
senses.why: The fixed phrase points back to an unbroken habit: the present occasion simply repeats what the line has done before.
senses.whyCN: 这个固定短语回指一条从未中断的习惯：这一次不过是那条线此前一直做的事情再重复一遍。

intro.en: Always began as an Old English phrase meaning all the way, and the road inside it is still visible in the sense.
intro.cn: always 最初是古英语里表示「全程」的短语，那条「路」至今仍留在词义里。

items.en: Ealne weg meant all the way, an accusative phrase built from eall all and weg way or road.
items.cn: ealne weg 意为「全程」，是由 eall「全部」与 weg「路」构成的宾格短语。

items.en: The phrase wore down into the single adverb alway, still meaning all the way or continually.
items.cn: 这个短语磨缩成单个副词 alway，仍表示「全程、不断地」。

items.en: An adverbial -es was added, giving alwayes; the same ending produced besides and towards.
items.cn: 后来又加上副词性的词尾 -es，成为 alwayes；besides 与 towards 也用了同一个词尾。

items.en: The forms alway and always competed, always won, and alway now survives mainly in poetry; exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: alway 与 always 两种形式并存竞争，最后 always 胜出，alway 如今主要见于诗歌；确切年代不确定。

items.en: The senses for ever and the annoyed repeatedly both grow from the same image of an unbroken road.
items.cn: 「永远」与带抱怨意味的「老是」，都从同一条没有断点的路的画面里长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the older form, the easily confused two-word phrase and a modern compound; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of unbroken repetition.
note.cn: 形近组收较早的形式、容易混淆的分写短语以及一个现代复合词；近义组收表示不间断重复的副词。

entries.definition: The older, shorter form of always, now found mostly in poetry and old texts.
entries.definitionCN: always 较早、较短的形式，如今多见于诗歌与旧文本。

entries.definition: A two-word phrase meaning in every way or by every route; it only sounds like always.
entries.definitionCN: 分开写的短语，义为「在各方面」或「走每条路」；只是听起来像 always，写法与意思都不同。

entries.definition: An adjective for a device or service that is never switched off.
entries.definitionCN: 复合形容词，义为「始终在线的、从不关闭的」，用于设备或服务。

entries.definition: Without stopping or very frequently; stronger on continuity than on exceptions.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「不断地、经常地」，强调连续多于强调「无例外」。

entries.definition: For all future time; it looks only forward, unlike always.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「永远」，只朝未来看，这一点与 always 不同。

entries.definition: Always, with no exception, in formal or academic use.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「总是、毫无例外」，多用于正式或学术语境。

entries.definition: Endlessly or continually, often with a hint of weariness.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「永久地、没完没了地」，常带一丝疲倦意味。

entries.definition: For endless time, used in literary or religious writing.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「永恒地」，多用于文学或宗教文字。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Old English phrase behind the word and the spellings that are easy to confuse.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用这个词背后的古英语短语，以及容易混淆的几种拼写。

normal.en: Always is ealne weg, all the way: one road with no break in it.
normal.cn: always 就是 ealne weg，也就是「全程」：一条没有断点的路。

normal.en: The -s at the end is an old adverbial ending, the same one seen in towards.
normal.cn: 词尾的 -s 是古老的副词词尾，与 towards 里的那个 -s 相同。

normal.en: Alway without the -s is the older form and now belongs to poetry.
normal.cn: 去掉 -s 的 alway 是较早的形式，如今属于诗歌。

normal.en: All ways, two words, means in every way; always, one word, means at all times.
normal.cn: 分开写的 all ways 意为「在各方面」；写成一个词的 always 意为「总是」。

normal.en: As always fixes a habit: the same thing, once more.
normal.cn: as always 固定住一个习惯：同一件事，又来一次。

abstract.en: Picture a single line drawn from the first page to the last without lifting the pen.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔画到底，从第一页画到最后一页，笔尖始终没有抬起。

abstract.en: Every point on the line is the same point: that is why the word can mean both every time and for ever.
abstract.cn: 线上的每一点都是同一点：正因如此，这个词既能表示「每次都」，也能表示「永远」。

abstract.en: Follow the line back far enough and it becomes a habit; pull it forward and it becomes a promise.
abstract.cn: 把这条线往回看足够远，它就成了习惯；往前拉，它就成了承诺。

examples.en: The old clock in the hall has always run a little fast.
examples.cn: 门厅里的那座老钟一直走得快一点。

examples.en: She always keeps a spare key under the flower pot.
examples.cn: 她总是把备用钥匙放在花盆下面。

examples.en: You can always ask the guard if you lose your way.
examples.cn: 要是迷路了，你总还可以去问门卫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥维兹」——那条路从头到尾都亮着灯：总是、永远

root: 古英语短语 ealne weg「全程、整条路」的宾格形式，eall 表「全部」、weg 表「路」；中古英语缩为 alway，后又加副词性词尾 -es 成 alwayes，最后定型为 always。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of always all follow one unbroken line: every time, for ever, annoyingly again and again, one remaining option, and the fixed phrase as always.
sensesIntro.cn: always 的五个义项都沿着同一条不断的线展开：每次都、永远、令人厌烦地一再发生、总还有一条退路，以及固定短语 as always。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line drawn from the first page to the last without lifting the pen.
core.cn: 核心意象：一笔从第一页画到最后一页，笔尖始终没有抬起。

branches.en: THE PATTERN: the line passes through every occasion, so no occurrence is missing.
branches.cn: 规律线：这条线穿过每一次场合，所以没有一次是缺的。

branches.en: THE HORIZON: the line runs past the visible end, so the action has no stopping point.
branches.cn: 地平线：这条线越过看得见的尽头，动作因此没有停止点。

branches.en: THE IRRITATION: the same line keeps returning when the speaker wants it to stop.
branches.cn: 烦躁线：说话人希望它停下，同一条线却一再返回。

branches.en: THE FALLBACK: because a route is always open, one more option can be offered.
branches.cn: 退路线：因为总有路通着，所以总能再给出一个办法。

branches.en: THE RITUAL: as always points back at the line and says it has done this before.
branches.cn: 惯例线：as always 回指那条线，说明它此前已经这样做了。

intro.en: Always is a worn-down phrase rather than a prefixed word; its parts are Old English words and one old ending.
intro.cn: always 是一个磨缩而来的短语，而不是加了前缀的词；它的组成是古英语的词和一个古老词尾。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic in origin, with no Latin ancestor, so no Latin cognates are listed.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词源自日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖形，因此不列拉丁同源词。

items.example: It supplies the first element of the old phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它提供这个古短语的第一个成分。

items.example: It is the source of the modern word way.
items.exampleCN: 它是现代词 way 的来源。

items.example: It is the form used in the original phrase.
items.exampleCN: 这是原短语里使用的形式。

items.example: It forms alwayes and also appears in towards.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 alwayes，也出现在 towards 里。

items.example: It survives mainly in poetry today.
items.exampleCN: 它今天主要保留在诗歌中。

items.example: The phrase fused into a single word.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语融合成了一个词。

items.meaning: in every way or by every route
items.example: It is often confused with the single word.
items.exampleCN: 它常与写成一个词的 always 混淆。

items.example: It describes a device or service.
items.exampleCN: 它用来形容设备或服务。
